Common questions

  • Is this only for HGV training providers?

    No. HGV training is the first category with live demos today. The Essential and Professional packages are for UK businesses more widely. More industry examples will be added as we expand.

  • What if I already have a website?

    Either package can replace the site you have now. Webco Media builds the new one. Webco Cloud then looks after hosting, the domain and email.

  • Can I upgrade later?

    Yes. Start with Essential when you have one location and a straightforward offer. When you need separate service and location pages, we move you onto the Professional Website and quote that work.

  • What if I already have a domain?

    We connect the domain you already own to the website and to your business email. A new domain can be registered during setup when you need one.

  • What if I add more services or locations?

    Essential covers one main location and your core service information. Several services or locations, each with its own page, are what the Professional Website is for.

  • Is booking, a shop, or custom software included?

    Both packages are enquiry websites. Online booking, ecommerce and bespoke systems are quoted separately.
